notes.title: Update Information
notes.notes:
The following updates were implemented during today's maintenance.

✔️ Fixed Matchmaking Errors
Even if a Custom Player is set with Skylab Triangle w/ Tachibanas, matchmaking errors will no longer occur.
With this fix, Skylab Triangle w/ Tachibanas can now be used in online matches with no issues.
We apologize for the inconvenience to our users, and we thank you for your cooperation in limiting the use of the above skill.

✔️ Fixed Faery Shot
The Faery Shot will now fly correctly into the goal post.


We deeply apologize for the inconvenience. 
We hope you continue to enjoy Captain Tsubasa: Rise of New Champions.

notes.title: Producer video and Update 1.31
notes.notes:
Help us improve your experience by filling out this survey!

The following updates have been implemented:

⚽ Displaying Move/Skill Prerequisites
Prerequisites for moves/skills in EPISODE: NEW HERO will now be displayed.

⚽ Custom BGM Functionality
BGM played during Versus and Online Versus can now be changed.
Look for custom BGM tracks in shops.

⚽ New Items Added to the CC Shop
"Online-based Player Slot" and "Online-based Team Slot" have been added to the CC Shop.
Please take advantage of this opportunity.

⚽ Changes to Matchmaking Settings
Added "Matchmaking with CPU On/Off" to Online Versus.
Also, "Matchmaking Range" was removed from the Matchmaking Settings.

⚽ Added Forfeit Functionality
It is now possible to forfeit Online Versus matches.

⚽ Changes to Division Match Costs
We have done away with costs based on rating and made the cost 1,600 for all ratings.
Along with this, you can now match with any rating in matchmaking player search from the start.

⚽ Adjustments to Normal Shots
We have made adjustments so that shots made without moves do not exceed a certain level of power.

⚽ Adjustments to Stacking Skill Effects
The following skills have been adjusted so that their effects do not stack when activated by multiple characters.

[Affected skills]
Sunshine Boy/Crushing Blocker/Pressure Monster/For Glory

⚽ Added Skip Functionality for Certain Parts of the Prologue
You can now keep the Game Guide from reappearing and skip the tutorial during the prologue.

⚽ Adjustments to Moves/Skills
Adjusted the descriptions and effects of some Moves/Skills.

[Affected Moves/Skills]
Pressure Monster/Miracle Assist/Charging Passer/Last Pass/Passing Expert/Pass Master

⚽ Fixes to Matchmaking
Fixed issue where users were not matched correctly when including
a custom player set with Skylab Triangle w/ Tachibanas in their team.

⚽ Other
Stability improvements have been made.


We hope you continue to enjoy Captain Tsubasa: Rise of New Champions.

notes.title: Update Information & New DLC Characters Available for Purchase
notes.notes:
The following updates have been implemented:

Hanawa MS Route
Hanawa MS Route for EPISODE: NEW HERO is now available.

New Characters Added (Paid DLC)
The 3 players Xiao Junguang, Pepe, and Taichi Nakanishi are now available.
*Purchase them from the store to use them.

Online Storage Functionality Added
Implemented functionality that allows you to save Custom Players and Custom Teams in online storage.
Eight Custom Player and five Custom Team slots can be used for free.

*We are planning to provide additional slots for purchase in a future update.
*By using the players in WorldStars, the default Custom Team, users who have not unlocked every team will be able to participate in future events.
*If you swap the players in the Custom Team WorldStars with players from any other team,
and have not unlocked every team, you might not be able to participate in events.

New Items Added to the CC Shop
Five new Hairstyles have been added to the CC Shop.
Please take advantage of this opportunity.

Balance Changes to Blake Dribble
Blake Dribble's effect On Success/Chain Success has been adjusted.

Balance Changes to Captain Skill Aztec Warrior Counter
Stats raised when activating Aztec Warrior Counter were higher than expected, so they have been adjusted.

Shot Move Cost Changes
The cost for some Shot Moves has been adjusted.

[Affected Shot Moves]
Razor Shot/☆ Double-Bladed Razor Shot/☆ Falcon Shot/☆ Neo Drive Shot/☆ Miracle Overhead/ ☆ Banana Shot

Skill Descriptions Updated
Some skills have had their descriptions adjusted.
*Actual effects of the skills are unchanged

[Affected Skills]
Fierce Tiger's Tenacity (Attack)/Finishing Touch

Other
Stability improvements have been made.


Today, we've begun offering 3 popular characters for purchase as part of the 3rd round of paid DLC. They are available in the store. Try 'em out!

Xiao Junguang (China/Midfielder)
A midfielder who's focused on a powerful counter-shot. With his insanely powerful block move Superspeed Kickback Cannon, if the power of his opponent's shot exceeds a certain level, he can shoot it back with even more power.
Also in his repertoire are Junguang Sliding, an exceedingly fast tackle that is great for defense, as well as Opportunist and Finishing Touch, which allow him to support the offense even from a rear-leaning position such as his.

Pepe (Brazil/Forward)
A forward specialized to be explosively powerful under certain conditions. Although it has short range and a hefty drop off, his Wild Shot is a top-tier, powerful shot.
What's more, his skill Master Blaster makes it even stronger. Shooting it at point-blank range would do some serious damage! And with his skill Hungry Striker, which stacks his power, his point-making prowess only grows later into games.

Taichi Nakanishi (Naniwa MS/Goalie)
One of the country's foremost goalies, he has clear strengths and weaknesses. With his characteristic skill Naniwa Bigshot GK, the chance for Critical Goals gets higher, but his save power against every other shot drastically increases.
And with skills like Upgrades and Winner's Confidence, which grow stronger while in the lead, when they all start to work together, they more than make up for their cost.

*DLC characters can be used in custom teams.
*They will also begin to appear as Friend Cards in Card Packs, and in EPISODE: NEW HERO's Select Appeal Groups.

The Nankatsu MS Route for EPISODE: NEW HERO is now available.

In all Division Match leagues, as well as Event Matches, players will be matched against the computer when they are unable to be matched with a player.

⚽ Misc.
Fixed a bug where skills were unable to be acquired when using Skip Story with the Skip All setting.
Fixed a bug where PP could not be earned after completing a Story Challenge.


Nankatsu MS Route Inaugural Login Bonus Event

We are celebrating the addition of the Nankatsu MS Route in Episode of New Hero by having an "Nankatsu MS Inaugural Login Bonus" event after maintenance on Wednesday, March 10!

Remember, you can earn rewards once per day when you log into the game!

⚽ Event Period
Following maintenance on Wed., March 10, 2021 until Tues., March 16, 2021 11:59 PM (UTC)

*You can claim bonuses the 1st day after maintenance ends.
*The time to get them that day will be shorter.
*Login Bonuses change every day at 12:00 AM (UTC).
*Claim login bonuses up to 5 times during the event period.
*Login bonus details may change without prior notice. Thank you for understanding.


Free Updates - Round 2 Release

Today, we added the Nankatsu MS Route to EPISODE: NEW HERO as part of Free Updates - Round 2.

It's available to everyone by updating to version 1.20.
We hope you enjoy it!

⚽ Features of Nankatsu MS Route
Of course, Nankatsu MS is home to the incredible Tsubasa, who dishes out precise passes all while
looking for opportunities of his own. However, for this route Tsubasa is recovering from his
injuries at Nationals and has to sit out. Can the new hero of the team fill in that Tsubasa-shaped
hole in the starting lineup and win the Junior Hero League?
Can Ishizaki find success as acting captain? Only one way to find out!


We hope you continue to enjoy Captain Tsubasa: Rise of New Champions!


Captain Tsubasa: RoNC Admin Team

notes.title: Patch 1.07 & Launch of Season 1
notes.notes:
To Captain Tsubasa players,

We would like share some good news!
We're still aware of several issues happening on the game and are investigating them.

In the meantime, please find the latest resolution made by the dev team!
- Animation becomes double-speed - [SOLVED]
- Low FPS issue - [SOLVED]

- Implementation of a ‘News’ Section
- CC Shop: At this new shop, you can trade in CC for items such useful for training,
Custom Parts for your avatar, and more, so check it out!
- Login Bonus added: You can earn CC (Captain Coins) once per day when you log into the game,so don't forget to do so! You can exchange CC at the CC Shop for items such as Training Items or Custom Parts for your avatar.
